_comment: Assignable standalone student activities (besides the 64 engine lessons) that should auto-grade in Canvas via SCORM. Each gets assets/canvas-bridge.js injected (tools/inject-canvas-bridge.js) and a SCORM package (npm run scorm:activities). Edit this list to add/remove. Excluded by design: hubs (math, curriculum), authoring/teacher studios, personal pages (noam-*, ecology-noam), and read-only novels. 'grade' = score (activity computes a %) or completion (full credit on finishing). Entry fields: path (dir with index.html, OR a direct .html file), optional query (appended to launch URL; requires explicit id), optional id (slug override), grade. injectOnly = extra pages that get the bridge injected but no package of their own (e.g. leveled variants of pre/post tests). Homework pages (lessons/*/homework.html) are derived from data/curriculum-manifest.json automatically — not listed here.
